=== usage
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
用法:create-idea-sandbox.py <名稱> <purpose>
輸出:最後一行是一個 JSON 物件(lease-runner 的 POST /v1/sandboxes 直接轉成回應):
  {"result": "created"|"exists_same", "name"}                              exit 0
  {"result": "bad_name"|"exists"|"too_many"|"create_failed", "detail", ...}  exit 1
  too_many 另外帶 limit、current。
- 重送:同名、同 purpose 已經登錄 → exists_same(Muninn 呼叫逾時重送不會開出第二個)。
- 撞名:同名但 purpose 不同、跟正式專案同名、或資料夾/bare repo/memory 副本已經存在 → exists。
- 上限:hub.json 的 ideas.limit(預設 20)個 type: idea 的專案。
- onboard 失敗:清掉這次建的資料夾、bare repo、memory 副本、還沒 commit 的登錄檔(事前都確認過不存在),
  再回 create_failed。
同時只跑一個(鎖在 <state>/idea-sandbox.lock):onboard 會 commit agent-hub。


=== bad name
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "bad_name", "detail": "名稱只能用小寫英文、數字跟 -(開頭結尾不能是 -,最多 40 字),收到 'Bad_Name'"}
--- stderr

=== platform name
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "agent-hub 是平台自己的名稱"}
--- stderr

=== empty purpose
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "bad_name", "detail": "purpose 不能是空的"}
--- stderr

=== purpose too long
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "bad_name", "detail": "purpose 太長(501 字,上限 500)"}
--- stderr

=== same idea again
exit 0
--- stdout
{"result": "exists_same", "name": "idea-1"}
--- stderr

=== another idea
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "idea-1 已經是另一個想法的名稱"}
--- stderr

=== a project
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "proj 已經是一個正式專案的名稱"}
--- stderr

=== folders exist
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "notes 沒有登錄,但這些已經存在:<TMP>/a/workspace/notes, <TMP>/a/go/notes-memory.git"}
--- stderr

=== onboard fails
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "create_failed", "detail": "onboard 失敗:step 1 ok / step 2 ok / boom: could not create the bare repo"}
--- stderr

=== onboard fails after commit
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "create_failed", "detail": "onboard 失敗:step 1 ok / step 2 ok / boom: could not create the bare repo(登錄檔已經 commit,沒有刪,要手動處理)"}
--- stderr

=== created
exit 0
--- stdout
{"result": "created", "name": "room-3d"}
--- stderr

=== README
# room-3d

探討用的專案(想法沙盒),由 Muninn 替這個想法開的:

> a 3D model of the room

深談的結論、決定、待辦記在 memory(`.agent-memory/`);要變成正式專案時用 agent-hub 的 `bin/upgrade-idea.sh`。

=== too many
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "too_many", "detail": "已經有 1 個想法沙盒(上限 1)", "limit": 1, "current": 1}
--- stderr
